result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall recommendation is **1Password if ease of use and team collaboration matter most; Bitwarden if keeping costs down is the priority.**

A business password manager is worth having even with only 3–5 employees. It lets you share access securely without sending passwords through email, Slack or WhatsApp, and revoke access when someone leaves.

## My top 4 choices

![Get to know 1Password for Mac | 1Password Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/C4U7UvvWr1lsit0fdwRMADZs7wYIji_AIA_d_hCeSHTTS1dPoJwwNeSzAPqWszRkpvDsM-p6I-6bznHJsD41eDQWYBj0MySy4qOfvgyzlD_4z3rPSGN9LVxo1hBQTb8qLml3yarSFkZEwcSqyJe7UAnBKtGHsXMSYuWNAwGS3UO1kE8Ogcbnaa14C9ioehoa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults for departments and projects.
- Granular permissions and access controls.
- Admin recovery and security reporting.
- Good integrations with business identity providers.

**Price\:** Teams Starter Pack around \$24.95/month for up to 10 users.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source core.
- Shared organisational collections.
- Strong admin and access-management features.
- Good browser and mobile apps.
- Option for self-hosting.

**Price\:** Teams approximately \$4/user/month, annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

(Best for administration)

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and team management.
- Detailed access permissions.
- Additional security and compliance features.

**Price\:** Business Starter from approximately \$2/user/month.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

(Best for privacy)

- End-to-end encrypted vaults.
- Secure sharing.
- Strong privacy-focused approach.
- Useful email alias functionality.

**Price\:** Business plans start around \$2/user/month, depending on tier.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices are indicative USD prices from November 2026 comparisons; check UK pricing, VAT and current plan limits before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for in a small business

Whichever you choose, I'd consider these essential\:

- **Shared vaults\:** Share credentials without revealing them through messages.
- **Individual accounts\:** Everyone has their own login.
- **Access management\:** Remove someone's access immediately when they leave.
- **Two-factor authentication\:** Protect the password manager itself.
- **Audit logs\:** See who accessed or changed shared credentials.
- **Emergency recovery\:** Avoid losing business access if an administrator leaves.

## My recommendation

I'd shortlist 1Password and Bitwarden. Both are excellent choices, but 1Password is particularly attractive if you want something straightforward that non-technical employees will happily use.

---
